goal: Reuse the private studio hardware source of truth, prioritize Samsung Android, and control approved USB hardware with upstream open standards rather than proprietary intermediary control services.

linuxStudioHost.purpose: Studio source, asset processing, USB tools, Android builds, and source-backed kernel experiments with bootable fallback.

appleIos.testerRole: Alex helps test when owner separately authorizes

openHardwareControl.default: Native Android public USB Host APIs, upstream standard USB class support, and trusted local Linux utilities
candidateUsbClasses: HID keyboard mouse controller where OS exposes input
USB Audio Class input and output
USB Video Class on host when supported
USB CDC serial only where allowed and actually identified
openHardwareControl.androidMode: USB host: enumerate device, display capability, request per-device runtime permission, bound interface and transfer; do not assume class capabilities or kernel access
openHardwareControl.linuxHostMode: Prefer in-tree Linux USB/HID/audio/video/serial support and userspace libusb/udev where needed; restrict uinput to trusted studio user if explicitly enabled
openHardwareControl.debugOnly: Android Platform Tools ADB over an owner-authorized USB connection; USB debugging must be explicitly enabled and device trust approved; no public ADB listener
openHardwareControl.localBridge: Use direct wired connection and approved ADB reverse/tether options where supported; fallback to authenticated LAN only when necessary
openHardwareControl.vendorDeviceModules: Keep Samsung Android GKI/KMI and signed vendor modules unmodified; never deploy a Linux desktop kernel image to stock Samsung
openHardwareControl.thirdPartyPolicy: No proprietary hardware-control broker, cloud relay, or paid middleware is required for base USB operation. Optional popular open-source components must be reviewed for source, permissions and license before addition.

uiAcceptance.primary: Portrait Samsung phone mode on both phone and tablet
uiAcceptance.responsive: One adaptive cockpit source, portrait default; desktop and web reuse the same permission-aware module contracts

kernelGate.host: Custom mainline-oriented Linux studio kernel is an independent host project; backup current known-good boot and validate DKMS/NVIDIA, USB audio/video/input, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth before adoption
kernelGate.phone: Stock Samsung vendor Android kernel remains unchanged; Android GKI/vendor compatibility is not a desktop mainline kernel replacement
